query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(container_registry_blob.size), 0)::BIGINT AS "image_size" FROM container_registry_blob INNER JOIN container_registry_repository_manifest ON container_registry_blob.digest = container_registry_repository_manifest.manifest_digest WHERE container_registry_repository_manifest.repository_id = $1 AND container_registry_repository_manifest.manifest_digest = $2;
